summary.name: Doughnut
summary.one_liner: Doughnut is an uncluttered, open-source podcast listening app for macOS, written in Swift.
use_cases: listen to podcasts on a Mac
subscribe to and manage podcasts on macOS
add podcasts that lack an RSS feed
keep podcast libraries on a network location
summary.what_it_does: Doughnut is a podcast listening app for macOS with a native interface that follows Apple's design language. It lets users search for podcasts and episodes and mark episodes as favourites. It supports adding custom podcasts that do not have their own RSS feed. Users can keep their library in a network location or maintain multiple libraries on one machine. The page describes the app as 100% open source and Swift-based.
notable: Custom podcasts added without an RSS feed
Library can sit on a network location or multiple libraries on one machine
Native macOS interface following Apple's design language
caveats: Requires macOS 10.15 or later; latest macOS recommended
